plan.diagnosis: Action 2 cup carry failed from unreachable transit_height, not from grasp. Asked tool z=0.45m along a far eastern detour. Evidence: at xy [0.71,0.209] max reachable is 0.43m and above via end [0.75,0.2] max is only 0.33m, radius ~0.74-0.78m from base. Reachability drops with radial distance, so 0.45m is impossible at the far end. Plan aborted during carry and cup was dropped, hence on(cup_1,coaster_1) xy offset 53.5cm. Straight start [0.33,0.3] to goal [0.68,-0.32] passes over stack center [0.5,0.0] which after stacking is 0.3m tall, so low height needs lateral avoidance. Fix: keep first two stacks which succeeded, lower cup transit to 0.25m (cup bottom 0.15m) which is below far-field max, and route west then south of the stack via [0.25,0.0] and [0.35,-0.28] to stay clear of the 0.26x0.2 footprint and stay at small radius where 0.25m is reachable.

Lower transit to 0.30m which is below the ~0.37m limit and route via [0.25,-0.2] close to base (dist ~0.32m) to stay reachable. The via also avoids the straight line from [0.33,0.3] to [0.68,-0.32] which passes through the new 0.3m high box stack at [0.5,0.0], allowing low carry with cup bottom at 0.20m without collision.
